name: halfOpenTable
tailDomain
complete_raw_region: def tailDomain (c : ℝ) : Set ℝ := Ico (max 1 c) 5

name: tableTail
complete_raw_region:
def tableTail (nums : Fin 200 → ℤ) (c : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ w in tailDomain c, upperFloor nums w / w

name: clippedCellLeft
complete_raw_region:
def clippedCellLeft (i : Fin 200) (c : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  min (floorGrid (i.val + 1)) (max c (floorGrid i.val))

name: upperTransition
complete_raw_region:
def upperTransition (lowerNums : Fin 200 → ℤ) (s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  tableTail lowerNums (max 2 (s - 1))

name: lowerTransition
complete_raw_region: def lowerTransition (upperNums : Fin 200 → ℤ) (s : ℝ) : ℝ := tableTail upperNums (s - 1)

name: adoptedHnew
complete_raw_region: def adoptedHnew : ℝ → ℝ := upperTransition adoptedH248Numerators

name: adoptedhnew
complete_raw_region: def adoptedhnew : ℝ → ℝ := lowerTransition H248Numerators
